cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Remember calling the spare chair unnecessary before giving its place to the cake? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then the guest sat on the piano stool, and you moved the pianist to the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until we open that window to cool the cake. Every sensible decision is now sitting on the next one.

mechanism: A manages party seating as cake, spare chair and piano stool repeatedly displace each other until A must hold the cake to free a seat.
confusable: A generic crowded-room problem lacks returning early details whose changed uses force one final arrangement.
comparison: Wedding-key alternative combines damaged objects into lost directions; this one combines borrowed seats into A unavoidable physical burden.
seedUse: Chair/cake/pianist seed supplies the causal chain; replace the imaginary window logistics with explicitly stated seat exchanges and a concrete standing outcome.
